mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xw_chat_task (task_id, session_id, skill_name, status, user_message) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{sessionId}, #{skillName}, 'pending', #{userMessage})
mapper.update: UPDATE xw_chat_task SET status = 'done', answer_markdown = #{answerMarkdown}, finished_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
UPDATE xw_chat_task SET status = 'failed', error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT task_id, session_id, skill_name, status, user_message, answer_markdown, error_message, hermes_run_id, current_phase, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM xw_chat_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId} LIMIT 1
SELECT task_id, session_id, skill_name, status, current_phase, created_at, finished_at FROM xw_chat_task WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
